title: Hyperparametric Influence Minimization: Feature-Driven Intervention Beyond Blocking

problem.claim: The paper addresses diffusion containment by minimizing diffusion from initial seeds through interventions on node feature values.

contributions.claim: A hyperparametric influence minimization model integrates hyperparametric diffusion with classical influence minimization and enables feature-based interventions on nodes.
The paper derives an upper bound on diffusion spread that quantifies the total uncertainty of nodes remaining inactive during diffusion and proves supermodularity for node selection.
The paper designs greedy-based algorithms for the hyperparametric influence minimization problem.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe the hyperparametric influence minimization model as novel.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that their greedy-based algorithms outperform state-of-the-art methods.

narrative_sequence.summary: Investigates diffusion containment through influence minimization.
Introduces a hyperparametric diffusion model with feature interventions for fine-grained control.
Analyzes intrinsic properties, derives a spread upper bound, and proves supermodularity.
Designs greedy-based algorithms and reports that they outperform state-of-the-art methods.
